title: Role-Based Access Foundation
notes: Adds centralized permissions for Administrator, Blaster, Driller, Driver, Viewer, and compatibility Member roles.
Restricts landing-page templates, conversion, editing, cloud writes, and cloud deletion by role.
Adds a read-only Viewer interface and direct-action access checks.
Adds an Administrator user-management screen for assigning roles and disabling accounts.
Moves secure profiles into a dedicated userProfiles collection while migrating existing member profiles.
Includes deployable Firebase rules so cloud permissions are enforced independently of hidden buttons.
Preserves landing login, offline verified-user access, permanent document identity, Hole Edit rotation, and cloud conflict safeguards.
